source.name: Artificial Analysis
source.attribution: Data: Artificial Analysis (https://artificialanalysis.ai/). Attribution is required wherever this data is shown.

field_notes.scope: Free API tier: composite indices, prices and speed. Per-benchmark scores (GPQA, HLE, Terminal-Bench, ...) need a Pro key and are not included.
field_notes.intelligence_index: 0-100 composite. Compare scores only within one index version (source.intelligence_index_version is major.minor).
field_notes.intelligence_index_rank: Competition ranking (1, 2, 2, 4) by intelligence_index among models that have one.
field_notes.capability_indices: AA's six capability indices; null when the model lacks a required evaluation.
field_notes.retired_indices: artificial_analysis_coding_index, artificial_analysis_agentic_index are null for every model (no longer published by AA) and are left out.
field_notes.reasoning_effort: Parsed from the trailing parenthesis of the name: none (Non-reasoning), enabled (Reasoning), minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max. variant_label keeps the original text.
field_notes.base_name: Name without the effort parenthesis; models sharing a base_name are effort variants of one model.
field_notes.intelligence_index_cost_usd: AA's cost to run the whole Intelligence Index (total) and per task.
field_notes.pricing_usd_per_1m_tokens: USD per 1M tokens. blended_3_to_1_computed = (3 x input + output) / 4, computed here (the API's blended price is Pro-only).
field_notes.performance: Performance v3 means (current methodology). legacy_median = older fields that AA returns as null from 2026-12-10.

indices.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
indices.description: Composite score across the evaluations in the current index version.
